I can only help with orders on the account of the person I'm assisting, and I can't access or act on another person's order, even with their permission. If order #W8309293 belongs to your cousin, they will need to contact us themselves.

To verify your identity, please provide either the email address on your account, or your first name, last name, and zip code. If you have any orders of your own with a broken item, I can look into those for you.
